phone.title: Continue with your phone number
phone.subtitle: We'll send you a 6-digit verification code.
phone.invalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
phone.legalHint: By continuing you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{phone}}.
otp.invalid: That code is wrong or expired. Please try again.
otp.cooldown: Please wait a bit before requesting another code.
otp.lockout: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
otp.throttled: Too many requests — try again shortly.

permissions.title: Almost there
permissions.locationBody: We use your location to show nearby stores and live deals. You can always search by district instead.
permissions.notificationsBody: We'll let you know when a favorite store publishes a new bag, or if you forget to pick one up.

discover.title: Discover
discover.emptyBody: We couldn't find a live bag near you at this hour. Try widening your search radius.
discover.errorBody: We couldn't load bags. Check your connection and try again.
discover.locationDeniedBanner: No location access — pick a district to browse instead.
discover.mapUnavailableWeb: Map view is available in the mobile app. Use list view for now.

search.emptyBody: We couldn't find anything for "{{query}}". Try a different word.
search.promptBody: Type a bag or store name, or pick a category.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.emptyBody: Favorite stores you like and see them here when they publish a new bag.
favorites.removeConfirmBody: {{name}} will be removed from your favorites.

orders.title: Orders
orders.emptyActiveBody: Find a new bag from Discover.
orders.emptyPastBody: Your first rescued bag will show up here.

offerDetail.title: Bag details
offerDetail.surpriseBody: This bag's exact contents are decided by the store and not shown in advance — it's made from that day's surplus. Photos are illustrative.
offerDetail.allergenBody: Contents vary day to day, so allergen information varies by store. This store hasn't provided an allergen disclosure — if you have allergies, always ask staff when you pick up.
offerDetail.noRefundBody: This is a food item. You can cancel for free up to {{hours}} hours before pickup; after that there is no right of withdrawal and the price is non-refundable.
offerDetail.loadError: This bag is no longer available.

purchase.title: Buy
purchase.unavailableBody: It may have sold out or been removed by the store. You can browse other bags nearby.
purchase.genericError: Your purchase couldn't be completed. Please try again.
purchase.consentLabel: I have read the Pre-Contract Information Form and the Distance Selling Agreement; I understand the contents are a surprise, the allergen warning, the pickup window rules, and that the right of withdrawal does not apply to this kind of food product.

payment.title: Payment
payment.waiting: Finish your payment with the provider. We'll continue automatically once it's confirmed.
payment.successBody: Your reservation is confirmed. You'll find your code under Orders.
payment.failedBody: Your reservation wasn't completed: the payment wasn't confirmed, or the bag is no longer available. You can browse other bags.
payment.loadError: The payment page couldn't be opened.
payment.closeConfirmBody: If you don't finish paying, your reservation won't be confirmed.

redeem.title: Pick up
redeem.swipeHint: Show this screen to store staff and swipe in front of them.
redeem.liveClockHint: This clock ticks live — proof it isn't a screenshot.
redeem.offlineBody: We confirmed this locally without a connection. We'll sync automatically once you're back online — keep showing this screen to staff.
redeem.notRedeemableTitle: This order can't be picked up right now
redeem.notRedeemableBody: The pickup window may not have started yet, or may already be over.
redeem.notStartedYetHint: It can't be picked up before this time — you can still show this screen to store staff.

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.body: Are you sure you want to cancel this bag?
cancel.noRefundNote: The cancellation window has passed, so this is non-refundable.
cancel.notCancellable: This order can no longer be cancelled.

rate.title: Rate your pickup
rate.thanksBody: Your rating was sent to the store.

profile.title: Profile
profile.logoutConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to log out?

notificationPrefs.title: Notification preferences
notificationPrefs.favoritesBody: Let me know when a favorite store publishes a new bag.
notificationPrefs.nearbyBody: Let me know when new bags are published near my location.
notificationPrefs.quietHoursBody: No notifications will be sent during these hours.

complaint.title: Complaint / support
complaint.submitted: Your complaint was sent — we'll get back to you soon.

complaints.title: My complaints
complaints.emptyBody: If something goes wrong with an order, you can report it from here.
complaints.replyError: Couldn't send the message. Please try again.

report.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the illegal, abusive, or inappropriate content…
report.submitted: Your report was received — our team will review it within 48 hours.

notFoundScreen.title: Page not found
notFoundScreen.body: The page you're looking for may have moved or never existed.

errors.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Payment couldn't be started. Please try again.
